changelog:
Initial release of Posture Patrol, a command-line tool for posture tracking and ergonomic improvement.

- Manual posture logging with quality scoring (good, fair, poor)
- Break reminders, posture streaks, and daily/weekly trend reports
- Spinal load calculation and ergonomic recommendations based on posture data
- Pattern analysis (e.g., slouch-prone times, fatigue)
- Desk stretch suggestions tailored to common posture issues
- Pure Python with local JSON storage; privacy-friendly
summary: Track your posture throughout the workday with manual logging, smart break reminders, ergonomic scoring, posture streaks, and trend analysis. Calculates spinal load, suggests desk stretches, tracks slouch patterns, and generates weekly posture reports with actionable recommendations.
